prerequisite: Real continuous T1 B and T2 own H150 branch, T3 same-live-parent B/H150/zero/raw-equivalent and at least actually executed zero/positive/negative RETURN-x3 responses under original gates
scope: one known-heavy engineering live parent; no independent patient, no clinical or hardware claim
action_permission: existing modal8_retimed x[3] only, other coordinates zero, legacy zero, same full H150 base, x3 in [-0.5,0.5], original endpoint locks/certificate/admission/activation/fallback unchanged
data_unit: same complete live parent plus exact full recipe and original full-task outcome; native samples and windows are correlated observations, not new patients
required_identity: exact action JSON and full H150 recipe SHA
actual accepted/rejected modal metadata and owned positive native receipts
original raw and independent scorer output SHA
constraint_targets: explicit per-component motion ratios and endpoint/duration margins retained when actually recorded
missing_data: Partial or absent complete costs are never filled. Failed/partial/rejected candidates enter separate execution records and count in attempt burden. No pseudo reward for unexecuted x3.
proposal_vs_applied: Requested x3 indexes a frozen intent-plus-original-fallback policy. An unaccepted or partly accepted intent is NOT an observed clean continuous plant response at that x3. Retain it in policy/executability diagnostics; fit clean local response only on audited activation/ownership-compatible rows, otherwise mark action-response identification incomplete.
first_model: separate small one-dimensional GP heads for paired JF, paired JM and selected motion margin, compared against linear/quadratic local regression and best actually qualified fixed x3; no deep network
mechanistic_variants: RBF versus Matern-3/2 tests smooth-response assumption near retimed 5ms scheduling changes
constrained expected improvement versus conservative paired-benefit lower bound tests exploratory acquisition versus conservative exploitation
cost+constraint heads versus cost-only ranking separates information from gate suppression
uncertainty_rule: Only observed same-parent repeat discrepancies and separately registered development prediction residuals may set an empirical uncertainty floor. Numerical solve jitter is not measurement-noise evidence. Three points from one Human do not calibrate a safety probability; all uncertainty is heuristic DATA_LIMITED.
objective: Minimize complete JF among candidates expected to retain the unchanged original qualification; JM and every native motion component remain separate reports. No weighted JF/JM/motion scalar and no claim all components improve.
candidate_selection: Preregister a finite query grid within the same x3 trust region, include exact H150 x3=0, exclude previously executed identical semantic action hashes from new-proposal claims. Require a positive conservative predicted paired gain to propose exploitation; if no candidate qualifies, report NO_ACTION_CHANGE rather than manufacture a physical success.
comparison: same-parent strongest complete qualified fixed perturbation
history-disabled or action-only model only where context labels actually support that comparison
online_vs_replay: The GP may consume only already completed actual child outcomes from the current live parent; next physical candidate freezes before its START. Subsequent cold or different-repetition state labels must not be treated as the same stationary parent.
independent_validation: A new frozen legitimate state or patient, with fresh native execution and full original scorer, is required before any generalization claim. A selected old child that has exited cannot be reconstructed from its hash and called a continuing Trial4. Any future live continuation protocol needs a separate owner/branch contract.
cumulative_exploration_burden: Count T1 commissioning/task, both real boundaries, T2/T3 live parents, all B/H150/zero controls, all failed/partial interventions, both signed fixed perturbations, ILC/gain/disabled arms, GP proposals, prediction fits/queries and all necessary validation. Parent common prefixes count once; each child starts at its actual fork. Previously collected labels are paid historical costs, not free new-patient observations.
efficiency_claim: Compare total and incremental native attempts/steps plus CPU against the same-start fixed/local method. One successful extra GP proposal after many paid labels is not net sample efficiency. No fixed global campaign attempt cap is introduced.
remaining: main-agent approval, actual clean local response data, source implementation and original-gate physical validation
